title: ARCADE SANDBOX: YOUR SAVE IS NEVER TOUCHED
why: His order of 2026-10-11: a 2 PLAYER ARCADE DEMO, a walk-up party mode for Halloween. This is build 1 of 20, the groundwork. While an arcade session is on, the game plays on a copy of the profile with one rifle, no stash, no kit, no contracts and default keys, and nothing is written to the save at all. Leaving the arcade puts his own profile back exactly as it was. Nothing in a normal raid changes, and nothing yet opens the arcade.
now: Groundwork for the 2 PLAYER ARCADE DEMO: an arcade session plays on a copy of your profile and never writes your save.
